queries.Core formalization: We will formalize de: Formalizing deception in communication partially observable Markov decision processes with speaker and listener agents, where messages update listener beliefs and actions, and deception is measured by regret in expected listener reward compared with prior beliefs.
queries.Regret-based deception metric: Our core: Regret-based deception metric in partially observable Markov decision processes comparing listener expected reward after speaker communication to reward from acting on prior beliefs, capturing belief and outcome deception in interactive dialogue.
queries.Communication POMDP design: We will defi: Communication POMDP models where a speaker observes world states and sends messages to a listener, who updates beliefs using a model of speaker behavior and takes actions that produce rewards based on updated beliefs, for studying deception and regret in interactive decision making.
queries.Reward function exploration: We will exp: reward function design for listener agents in communication POMDPs measuring deception through task-based rewards and belief-accuracy rewards, regret-based impact of speaker messages on listener beliefs, actions, and utilities, unifying existing deception definitions
queries.Conversational scenario design: We will: Designing conversational scenarios for deception research in house bargaining, nutrition consultation, and workplace small talk, where a speaker reveals selected features to a listener and human participants rate deceptiveness based on private information, prior beliefs, and decision outcomes.
queries.Scenario generation and dialogue convers: Programmatically generating conversation scenarios for deception studies and using large language models to translate symbolic POMDP speaker actions into natural language dialogue for evaluating listener belief updates and regret-based deception metrics
queries.Conversational user study: We will condu: user study with fifty participants rating deceptiveness of ten random conversational scenarios per situation, producing one thousand five hundred interactions, and correlating human Likert ratings with regret-based deception metrics in communication POMDPs
queries.Conversational rating procedure: Partici: user study where participants rate deceptiveness of speaker messages on a Likert scale after seeing private speaker features, listener prior beliefs, selectively revealed features, and listener preferences in conversational decision-making scenarios
queries.Interactive dialogue system: We will bui: Interactive dialogue management system simulating housing scenario with human preferences and AI representative sharing house features, LLM natural language dialogue, POMDP communication, regret-based deception metric, and user study ratings of deceptive agent behavior.
queries.Interactive dialogue action selection: T: LLM-based dialogue management converting POMDP actions into natural language and randomly selecting actions to maximize or minimize deceptive regret in interactive speaker-listener communication
queries.Interactive dialogue user study: We will: interactive dialogue user study where participants converse with AI agents and rate perceived deception, correlating human ratings with real-time regret-based deception metrics from POMDP communication models
queries.LLM negotiation generation: We will use: Large language model generation of negotiation dialogues in a Deal No Deal two-agent three-item splitting game with asymmetric information, strategic preference deception, belief updates, regret-based deception measurement
queries.Negotiation setup modification: We will: LLM-generated Deal or No Deal negotiation dialogues with asymmetric information, where one agent knows the other agent's point values and the other holds only prior beliefs about the first agent's values, creating strategic deception about preferences for regret-based deception analysis.
queries.Negotiation belief extraction and regret: chain-of-thought prompting to extract prior beliefs, posterior beliefs, and speaker actions from generated negotiation dialogues and compute deceptive regret values in LLM-based Deal or No Deal interactions
queries.Negotiation user study: A user study wit: human deception ratings in a thirty-participant user study of LLM-generated splitting negotiation conversations, correlation with regret-based deception metrics for strategic preference deception
queries.Correlation evaluation: For all experime: correlation between human deception ratings and regret-based deception metrics in communication POMDPs, including task regret, belief regret, and combined regret for evaluating deceptive speaker agents
queries.Baseline comparison: We will also compar: Comparisons of large language models such as GPT-4, LLaMA, and Google Bard as baselines for detecting deception in human-AI conversations, evaluating whether a regret-based formalism outperforms existing LLM deception assessments in user studies.
queries.Statistical analysis: Statistical signif: statistical significance p-values correlation analysis of which regret formulation components task regret belief regret combined regret best predict human deception judgments across scenarios
